annotation.title_clean: Law No. (9) of 2023 Regulating the Operation of Autonomous Vehicles in the Emirate of Dubai
annotation.title_en: Law No. (9) of 2023 Regulating the Operation of Autonomous Vehicles in the Emirate of Dubai
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ruler of Dubai; Supreme Legislation Committee in the Emirate of Dubai
annotation.venue: Supreme Legislation Committee in the Emirate of Dubai
annotation.summary_en: Dubai Law No. 9 of 2023 regulates operation of autonomous vehicles in the Emirate. It empowers the RTA to license vehicles, issue activity permits, mandate technical inspections, collect and classify operational data, monitor permit holders and handle complaints. Traffic law applies where the Law is silent; it takes effect 90 days after publication.
key_provisions_or_claims: No autonomous vehicle may travel on a road without an RTA licence.
Activities involving autonomous vehicles require an RTA permit.
Autonomous vehicles must undergo technical inspection and can be recalled for re-inspection.
RTA compiles and classifies data generated by AV operation and monitors permit holders' compliance.
Federal road traffic law applies where this Law is silent; effective 90 days after publication.
